title: Anything but Mountains!
overview: Aoi spends most of her time alone, but an old friend from middle school has arrived to make good on an old promise.

title: Let's Go Together!
overview: With the help of Hinata's dad, the girls familiarize themselves with the necessary gear to climb.

title: Mountain Climbing Is Dangerous!?
overview: Hinata convinces Aoi to try climbing a mountain, but Aoi thinks they should start with a small mountain and work their way up to the big ones.

title: Showdown! Mountain Cooking!?
overview: Aoi and Hinata have a camping cook-off.

title: What's a Schlafsack?
overview: Aoi meets a girl from her school who is crazy about backpacking.

title: I'm the One Deciding!?
overview: It's Aoi's turn to pick the mountain, so she calls on her new friend to help.

title: Which Daypack Do You Want?
overview: Aoi picked the mountain but now she needs the right equipment.

title: Let's Climb Mt. Takao!
overview: Aoi and Hinata embark on their second climb and meet some interesting people along the way.

title: A Forest Girl in the Forest!?
overview: Hinata teaches Aoi, mountain manners and learns about giant flying squirrels.

title: The Climb Isn't Over Until You Descend!?
overview: Aoi, Hinata, and Kokona help each other down the mountain.

title: Tomorrow Is Outdoors!
overview: In preparation for their next trip, Aoi invites Kokona over to help her cook snacks.

title: To the Next Landscape
overview: Aoi, Hinata, Kaeda, and Kokona meet up for a picnic at Hannou River.
